name: @plebeian-apps/composition
description: The composition rung (sdk/core/composition): the one place a composition root may name its siblings. It builds the validator from the host's declared demands, wires validator.accept into event-access's one accept hook (composeEventAccess, relocated verbatim by V0), and — from V2 on — owns the declaration registry and its guard. It declares no third-party dependency of its own: it imports only its siblings, by path, named in ./siblings.ts.
